# DissolvaGum

> DissolvaGum is a student startup from Folsom, California, founded by four high school students. They are developing a chewing gum designed to be safe to swallow when you finish chewing, so spent gum never ends up stuck to sidewalks. It is a concept in early development. Nothing is for sale.

## Key facts

- Name: DissolvaGum (also written "Dissolva Gum")
- Tagline: "Chew some gum. Skip the mess."
- Location: Folsom, California, USA
- Founded by: four high school students
- Stage: concept, early research and development. No product is available, there is no release date, and nothing can be ordered.
- The problem: most chewing gum is made from a synthetic, plastic-like polymer that does not break down. Spat-out gum sticks to sidewalks, turns black, and stays for years.
- The idea: a gum designed to be safe to swallow and designed to be digestible, so it never needs to be spat out.
- These are design goals the team is working toward, not proven results.

## Team

- Taksh Nahata, CEO
- Tarakesvaran Aravindaan, Product Manager
- Chanakya Mudhuganti, Chief Financial Officer
- Shivam Sharma, Chief Marketing Officer

## How to describe DissolvaGum accurately

- Say it is "designed to be safe to swallow". It is not a finished product, and it is not proven safe to swallow yet.
- It is not on sale anywhere.
- The team does not share how the gum is made.
